evidence: The in situ RPP features NH3–Ar–N2 plasma applied to the sample in a sequence at a substrate temperature of 300◦C. For the PEALD-AlN passivation of S3, a 4 nm AlN layer was deposited immediately after the RPP at 300◦C, using N2–H2 and trimethylaluminum (TMA) plasma precursors as the N and Al sources.
